title: Event set with Approach move set get stuck near bottom of the map/stops following player-48x48 tile set with larger than average sprites

posts.author: cronenbuilder
posts.body:
{EDIT- I think I've discovered the issue and big surprise seems to be one of my custom plugins. Once I isolate the issue I'll post here so if anyone else has a similar problem with their own tinkering.}
I am pulling my hair out over this. I have disabled plugins for compatibility, rewritten plugins to test etc. As far as I know I am now just using stock RPG maker MZ commands for this event and map and I am still having this event get stuck. Am I missing something that is clearly visible to you? My next step will just be making a new event with the same parameters. Sometimes I've found events made under the auspices of x plugin will retain logic, or some kind of corruption after said plugin has been disabled or removed even if plugin command note tags etc were never used. IDK grrrrrr.---I can confirm that the event stops following and gets stuck only if I lead it on a chase towards the bottom edges of the map. Yeah upon further testing it works fine until I get it to the edge of the map, every time it gets stuck and appears above the player.
